brandKits.title: My brands
brandKits.intro: Keep your brand's colours, logos and style here, for the Graphic designer in the chat.
brandKits.limitReached: You've reached your plan's brand kit limit ({{count}}).
brandKits.emptyBody: Create one here, or pick the Graphic designer in a new chat to set it up step by step.

newDialog.title: New brand kit
newDialog.body: Enter the brand name. You can add colours and files next.

notFound.title: Brand kit not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted. Go back to your brand kits.

draftNote.title: This brand kit isn't finished yet
draftNote.body: Finish it with the Graphic designer in the chat: pick this kit and answer the questions.

identity.title: Name
identity.body: Shown in your list and to the designer in the chat.
identity.label: Brand name
identity.required: Enter a name for the brand kit.

colors.title: Colours
colors.body: Order the colours from most to least important. The first is the main colour of your designs.
colors.invalid: Enter a colour code such as #1A4B8C.
colors.duplicate: This colour is already in the palette.
colors.full: You have 12 colours. Remove one to add another.
colors.suggestedNote: Colours are added only when you press Add.

assets.title: Files
assets.body: Each file goes in its group. You can delete any file at any time.

logo.title: Logos
logo.body: Your logo in its different forms. We suggest colours from it.

reference.title: Past designs
reference.body: Earlier work the designer follows for style.

product.title: Product photos
product.body: Photos of your products or services.

guideline.title: Brand guidelines
guideline.body: Your logo and colour guide, if you have one.

assets.drop: Drop files here or click to choose
assets.hintImages: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 10 MB each
assets.hintGuideline: PDF up to 20 MB, or an image up to 10 MB
assets.limitReached: This brand kit has 40 files. Delete some to add more.
assets.deleteError: Couldn't delete the file. Try again.
assets.uploadFailed: Couldn't upload the file. Check your connection and try again.

profile.title: Style and instructions
profile.body: The Graphic designer uses these to design in your brand's voice. All optional.
profile.fontStyleHint: Describe how your fonts look. No font name needed.
profile.ruleTooLong: The rule is longer than 200 characters.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: You have unsaved changes to this brand kit. If you leave, they will be lost.

delete.title: Delete brand kit
delete.body: The kit and all its files are deleted for good. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmBody: The kit and its files are deleted for good. This can't be undone.
delete.error: Couldn't delete the brand kit. Try again.
